method: insert digital silence at the quietest 20 ms of each gap; no other processing

gaps.beat: after "dying." - the camera tips from the wrist toward the band underside and a clean section opens in the arm
after "skin." - the sensor stream reaches the vessel; one hero sensor is singled out
after "decay." - the hero signal pulses; pull back along the vessel to the same man, opened in section
"fail, | or" - a comma breath inside the sentence; the failing organ dims under the sensors
"rhythm, | the device" - a comma breath inside the sentence; the heart quivers and its signal leaves for the arm
after "exact second." - red 00:02:14 holds; his eyes find the screen, the wrist turns, the hand reacts
after "help." - the diagnostic resolves and the blue alert ring leaves the band
"data, | potentially" - natural, unchanged (one connected emergency-services sentence)
after "consciousness." - treatment pulse response, breathing, he plants a hand and sits up; the band turns green
"starts, | would" - a comma breath; attention moves from the green readout to his worried face
